what: Mistake: told Sri that Athena's retry of a rejected job redoes the work from scratch, and suggested he ask Athena to fix flagged findings instead. Athena already does this: the retry brief starts from the rejected candidate and asks the producer to address only the findings (the instructions retry cost $1.33 against $6.55).
why: I reasoned from the retry command's help text instead of reading a retry's brief; Sri nearly sent Athena a request for behavior it already has. Rule: check the records before claiming what Athena does.
